Title: "Type" Questions (was Re: Types for allies and retainers)

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
*** Disclaimer: Before anyone posts any replies discussing it: 1. I know that
Jyhad/VTES the CCG is different from the World of Darkness RPG's and 2. I know
that some things are done to make them simply and easier to understand.

>With Final Nights, we've started referring to some allies and retainers by
>type.

First of all let me aplaud you and White Wolf for this! I think this is a great
way to bring structure and organize the cards that are already out as well as
to provide a springboard for future ideas. And it also helps add more elements
of the World of Darkness to the flavor of the game by fleshing out the cards
more.

A few questions though:

#1. Is "type" an official term or is it more of a slang/conceptual idea?

#2. Can an ally/retainer have more than one type? (From the classification of
Hell Hound, who IMHO should be both a "Ghoul" and "Animal," since it's a
ghouled dog, I'm guessing no). But I'd still like an official ruling. While I'm
not going to argue how techincally (taxonomically) all these "mortals" are
actually "animals" (kingdom phylum class order family genus species), the World
of Darkness has always seemed to emphasize that all the Mages are mortals.

#3. Are there sub-types? In particular, I'm thinking about the Bane Mummies.
There are 5 Mummies right now and 4 of them are "Bane Mummies." But exactly
what is a "Bane Mummy?" A sub-type?

Some comments:

With the classification for Mummies, Werewolves, Mages, Wraiths, and
Changelings, I am a bit disappointed that there is no "Hunters" category (for
the Imbued). I'm no fan of Hunter: The Reckoning myself (it's a Buffy-wannabe
twinkfest IMO) but I think it would be more consistent to include them. Of
course it might confuse people since not all hunters are Hunters (Imbued) but I
got the impression that at the very least, Wendell Delburton is one (the regen
ability really makes him seem supernatural). BTW: Is there any canonical info
on Wendell?

>Mage - Talaq the Immortal (ally)

Is Talaq (in the RPG) really a Mage? I heard something weird about him being an
ex-Assamite or something...

>Mortal - Political Ally (ally)
>Mortal - Political Antagonist (ally)

Shouldn't snakes be classified under "Animal?" Or maybe a new category called
"Amorph" to define the spineless slimes they are! =)

>* Camarilla Vitae Slave (retainer)

Cammie lackey? Cam thrall?

>* Homunculus (retainer)

Magical construct?

So once again, well done LSJ and friends! =)

Halcyan 2

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
halc...@aol.com (Halcyan 2) wrote:
>#1. Is "type" an official term or is it more of a slang/conceptual idea?

It's as official as any other card text.
"Weapon" is officially a type of equipment.
"Werewolf" is officially a type of ally.

>#2. Can an ally/retainer have more than one type? (From the classification of
>Hell Hound, who IMHO should be both a "Ghoul" and "Animal," since it's a
>ghouled dog, I'm guessing no). But I'd still like an official ruling. While
I'm
>not going to argue how techincally (taxonomically) all these "mortals" are
>actually "animals" (kingdom phylum class order family genus species), the
World
>of Darkness has always seemed to emphasize that all the Mages are mortals.

Some equipment are both "guns" and "weapons", so multi-typing is
certainly possible. None of the current allies/retainers are
multi-typed, however.

>#3. Are there sub-types? In particular, I'm thinking about the Bane Mummies.
>There are 5 Mummies right now and 4 of them are "Bane Mummies." But exactly
>what is a "Bane Mummy?" A sub-type?

A designation of a card's title. And a type.
Like all guns are weapons, all bane mummies are mummies.

>BTW: Is there any canonical info
>on Wendell?

He is referenced in Hunter: Avengers

>

an

If you have a source, pass it along. Thanks.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:
>>>Mage - Talaq the Immortal (ally)
>>
>>Is Talaq (in the RPG) really a Mage? I heard something weird about him being
>
>an
>>ex-Assamite or something...
>
>If you have a source, pass it along. Thanks.

I don't have a source myself, but I remember a while ago on this newsgroup we
were discussing the backgrounds of various cards and someone mentioned how
Talaq was originally an Assamite and somehow became mortal or something. It's
quite possible that whoever said it was wrong though. I'll have to search the
archives sometime.

>>>* Homunculus (retainer)
>>
>>Magical construct?
>
>It isn't magical (it's protean).

As Aaron pointed out, Homonculi are supposed to be created in a special ritual.
I know for certain they're discussed in the "minions" section in the original
Tremere Clanbook (along with Corpse Minions) and I'm pretty sure they're
discussed briefly in the new Clanbook (there's supposed some discrepancy in the
level for the ritual in the two books or something).

It's just that "Homonculus" is *supposed* to be a thaumaturgical magic thingy.
Just like "Wake with Evening's Freshness" is *supposed* to be a thaumaturgical
ritual. And "Eternal Vigilance" is *supposed* to be a high-level Fortitude
power. But then again, what is ever the way it's *supposed* to be? =)

Halcyan 2
